system.description:
Will Amp

When you would enter Overheat, by spending 2 Focus, you enter Burnout. You gain the benefits of Overheat, you gain 1 Pyroclasm at the end of each of your turns and you may use the Detonate ability as a bonus action, treating it as a Ninjutsu with the Release being cast.

While in Burnout, you take 3d6 fire damage at the end of each of your turns. This damage cannot be reduced, resisted or ignored by any means.
system.summary: Overheat, plus 1 Pyroclasm at the end of each turn and Detonate as a Bonus Action; take 3d6 fire at the end of each of your turns.

rules.text: Overheat's damage bonus, +1 Pyroclasm and 3d6 unreduced fire damage to you at the end of each turn (on this effect); Detonate as a Bonus Action, treated as a Fire Release Ninjutsu. Also spend 1 Pyroclasm.
rules.label: Chakra Surge: Crash (Burnout)

rules.text: Once per casting, Ninjutsu you cast deal +3d10 damage (half the dice for an area). This is added automatically when you cast.
You can use two or more Moldings on one casting; you can use the Draw Reserves skill action as an Action.
